is_anopheles.evidence: The study assessed insecticide susceptibility and resistance markers in Anopheles gambiae s.s. collected in Lambaréné, Gabon (Page 1, Abstract; Page 4, Results).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Mosquitoes were genotyped for Vgsc-L1014F (Vgsc L995F), Vgsc-L1014S (Vgsc L995S), and Ace-1 G119S (Ace-1 G280S) using TaqMan assays (Page 4).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Page 4: 'All the 94 mosquitoes screened for the presence of the knockdown resistance genes were either homozygous (98.4%) for Vgsc-L1014F or heterozygous (1.6%) for Vgsc-L1014F and Vgsc-L1014S... By contrast, all the mosquitoes screened for the Ace1 mutation were carrying the G119 Ace-1 susceptible allele of the gene.'

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected from breeding sites in Lambaréné, Moyen Ogooué province, Gabon between December 2021 and May 2022 (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research study reporting novel field collection, bioassay, and genotyping data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Collections were conducted in the second district of Lambaréné, Moyen Ogooué province, Gabon, with specific breeding sites mapped (Page 2 & Fig. 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field collection took place from December 2021 to May 2022 (Page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The authors describe routine new field collections of Anopheles gambiae larvae in Lambaréné, Gabon during 2021-2022.

supplement.evidence: The target marker genotype proportions and sample size (n=94) as well as bioassay results are reported in the main text and figures.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and target-site resistance markers (Vgsc L1014F/S and Ace-1 G119S) in Anopheles gambiae s.s. collected from Lambaréné, Gabon between December 2021 and May 2022. High frequency of Vgsc-L1014F (98.4% homozygous) and low Vgsc-L1014S (1.6% heterozygous) were reported in 94 genotyped mosquitoes, while the Ace-1 G119S resistance mutation was absent.
